function.name: search
function.description: Search the user's archived emails and files by keyword and meaning. Returns matching items with id, title, sender, date and a short snippet, plus the total number of matches.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words. Do not put sender names or dates here; use the other arguments.

sources.description: Limit to these archives. Omit to search everything.

after.description: Only items on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

before.description: Only items before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

function.name: get_item
function.description: Get the full text and details of one email or file, by the id a search returned.

id.description: Item id from a search result.

function.name: get_email_thread
function.description: Get every message in the conversation an email belongs to, oldest first.

id.description: Id of any email in the thread.

function.name: list_items
function.description: List emails or files by date, without a search query. Use for 'what came in last week' style questions.

function.name: list_collections
function.description: List the archives the user has imported (email accounts, drives, folders), with item counts.
